items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: When you say Sesame Street you’re referring to “Jelly Man Kelly?”

ctx.x: So you made some appearances on television: Sesame Street, do those things come around because somebody knows somebody and yeah, Howard can do this?
Yeah. That’s what does happen. When you say Sesame Street you’re referring to “Jelly Man Kelly?”
